name: Pizzeria Ramazotti
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Ramazotti in Tirol**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Ramazotti** in the heart of **Tirol**, where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the Alps. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a fresh **Caprese**, our handmade pizzas are baked to perfection in a traditional wood-fired oven.

Pair your meal with a crisp glass of Italian wine or a refreshing **Radler**—just like the locals do. After dinner, take a stroll through **Innsbruck**’s lively streets or enjoy the breathtaking views of the **Nordkette** from our cozy terrace.

Come for the food, stay for the **Tiroler** hospitality—**Pizzeria Ramazotti** is your taste of Italy in the mountains!
